comment: Website Crafter's Process page config for a website repo, from Git Crafter's starter (templates/process/config.json at v7.1.0). Copy it to quality/process/config.json and replace my-site (repos, repo_url, heading) and OWNER (repo_url). It is also the repo's maps file (docs.maps names it). It keeps the three library maps whose every step reads a tab the website quality starter keeps: delivery, deploy and code. Keys: Git Crafter actions/pages/action.yml; maps: pages/maps/README.md.
